articles.summary: BOULDER, Colorado—June 11, 2019 — OnKure, Inc. and the University of Colorado Cancer Center today announced enrollment of the first patient in a first-in-human phase 1 clinical trial testing investigational anti-cancer agent OKI-179, a novel and Class-selective HDAC inhibitor, in patients with advanced solid tumors. articles.title: OnKure and CU Cancer Center announce first patient enrolled in clinical trial of OKI-179, a potent and selective HDAC inhibitor
